before: The user, who said they have run two bakeries since 2015, wants one blog article a week for search. The summary said: every Wednesday 7:00 am (Denver), Bolta drafts 1 researched article about running a small bakery, with an SEO title and description, in the brand voice; it never publishes: once approved, they publish it. WordPress is connected.

arguments.name: Weekly article, running a bakery
arguments.goal: One researched article a week that helps people thinking of opening a small bakery, so they find us

longform.topic: Practical lessons on opening and running a small neighbourhood bakery

arguments.instructions: Write from our experience running two bakeries since 2015. Never invent facts, numbers, prices or dates.

steps.why: A weekly article, not weekly posts: search traffic comes from pages on their site, and they have one. artifact_type article, count 1 (most 2). The weekly article takes only outputFormat article. No auto: articles always wait. No social accounts: it writes an article, not posts.
Switching on runs nothing until Wednesday.
Read next_run_at back in the brand's clock.

say: Bolta routine on: Weekly article. First draft Wed Nov 18, 7:00 am (Denver), waiting for your yes; once approved, you publish it to WordPress.
never: Saying it publishes weekly: it drafts, the user publishes.
outputFormat thread or carousel on the weekly article: refused.
